notes.title: Spark is now available on Windows and Mac!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34869670/be21041fd5005d7f0e26ce8de9c3d65f83a0a3f2.png[/img]

Spark and The Digital Daydream has officially released on Steam! In this short & free indie game, you will guide Spark on an electrifying journey through his creator’s computer, using live-action videos as a tool to solve puzzles and to traverse the 2.5D environment. It’s been a blast putting the game together, and I truly hope you enjoy!

Website: https://luminescenceinteractive.com
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC4bAP0iBH4G1ChDgJgTLfJw
